# Pharmko

> Pharmko is a specialized home infusion pharmacy providing USP 797 sterile compounding, parenteral nutrition solutions, and renal care services across multiple states.

Pharmko operates as an ACHC-accredited home infusion pharmacy with expertise in total parenteral nutrition (TPN), intradialytic parenteral nutrition (IDPN), intraperitoneal nutrition (IPN), and comprehensive sterile compounding for patients requiring specialized nutritional and IV therapies.

## Key Topics

- Home Infusion Therapy
- Sterile Compounding
- Parenteral Nutrition
- USP 797 Compliance
- Total Parenteral Nutrition (TPN)
- Intradialytic Parenteral Nutrition (IDPN)
- Renal Care & Dialysis Support
- IV Therapy
- Specialty Pharmacy
- Multi-State Coverage
- Insurance Coordination
- Compounded Medications
- Clinical Support
- ACHC Accreditation
- Renal Nutrition

## Core Services

- [Home Infusion Services](https://www.pharmko.com/home-infusion): Pharmko home infusion therapy with USP 797 sterile compounding and multi-state coverage
- [Sterile Compounding Services](https://www.pharmko.com/sterile-compounding): Pharmko's USP 797 sterile compounding for injectables, infusions, and specialty medications
- [Parenteral Nutrition Solutions](https://www.pharmko.com/parenteral-nutrition): Pharmko's TPN, IDPN, and IPN parenteral nutrition services for dialysis and renal care

## Parenteral Nutrition Specialties

- [Total Parenteral Nutrition Solutions](https://www.pharmko.com/home-infusion/tpn-total-parenteral-nutrition): Pharmko's personalized TPN formulations for short bowel syndrome and Crohn's disease
- [Intradialytic Parenteral Nutrition Solutions](https://www.pharmko.com/idpn-intradialytic-parenteral-nutrition): Pharmko IDPN therapy for dialysis patients with malnutrition and protein-energy wasting
- [Intraperitoneal Nutrition Solutions](https://www.pharmko.com/ipn-intraperitoneal-nutrition): Pharmko IPN solutions for GI failure, radiation enteritis, and IBD patients
